topic: Structured tool result with error_type and suggested_fix
idea: Every tool returns O = {status, error_type, message, artifacts, suggested_fix}; coarse error categories (EDGE_NOT_FOUND, NO_PATH, GRIDLOCK) let the planner reason about cause and pick a minimal corrective action.
does: Make each ACMS tool failure return a machine-readable error_type plus a suggested_fix hint (e.g. unknown road id: nearest ids; unroutable OD: list the disconnected pair) so the LLM self-corrects.
existing: partial: validate-before-change refusals give messages; analyse_network lists unreachable junctions
notes: ACMS refusals already text; adding typed codes and fixes is cheap and testable.

topic: Self-healing loop with bounded recovery iterations
idea: After a failure the agent continues the normal plan-execute-observe loop with a cap of K recovery iterations; recovery actions: re-ground references, alternative edges/junctions, regenerate routes, scale demand down, revert last modification.
does: Wrapper for headless run that, on gridlock/no path/zero arrivals, reports the diagnosis and tries a limited set of fixes (scale demand, revert last edit) up to K times, logging each.

idea: Failure classes: referenced element missing; OD not routable (disconnected subgraph, discarded vehicles, empty output); demand saturation causing gridlock, teleports or stagnation.
does: After a run, flag gridlock (no vehicle moved for T s with queued cars), unroutable OD pairs, spawn-blocked demand and stagnation, with the likely cause.
outputs: health flags per class with offending ids
notes: Check whether ACMS already reports unserved demand / insertion backlog.

idea: Inject EDGE_NF, NO_PATH, GRIDLOCK on small/medium/large networks at time t0; metrics: recovery success rate, recovery iterations (extra tool calls to first successful run), time-to-recovery (wall clock). Reported success 0.95 to 0.78.
does: Test harness for AI Mode: inject faults into a network, let the assistant fix it, score success rate, tool calls, time.
notes: Numbers in paper are unexplained (no n, no variance).

idea: T_insight = sum over interaction steps of (T_compute + T_human); compare agent vs semi-manual workflow; agent removes human time while compute stays the same.
does: Log compute vs human wait per assistant task to measure the benefit of AI Mode.
inputs: timestamps of tool calls and user turns

topic: Agent state S_t = <G, A, H, C> with planner JSON schema and rule-based fallback
idea: Persistent state of goal, artifacts, step history (action, params, outcome, timestamps, KPIs) and context; planner emits one schema-constrained decision (action, params, rationale); invalid actions are mapped to safe alternatives, extraneous params filtered, and a rule-based fallback planner guarantees progress; state-driven lifecycle (no network -> build; no demand -> routes; ready -> run -> analyse).
does: Filter tool args to schema, remap invalid calls, and a deterministic next-step fallback when a small local model (Ollama 3B-8B) cannot chain tools.
existing: partial: guided mode for small local models
notes: Directly addresses ACMS's not-built gap on small models chaining tools; ACMS guided mode covers building and testing.

idea: Success defined as (i) named roads grounded to valid edges, (ii) feasible path exists between the grounded sets, (iii) assigned demand within 1% of the stated volume; compared against random-trip baseline with same total flow.
does: After the assistant sets demand from a natural-language description, verify the three conditions and report mismatch.

idea: Traffic Metrics Provider returns normalised summaries (mean speed, travel-time statistics and longest trips, edge density, total emissions and energy) injected into the agent state rather than raw logs.
does: Compact KPI digest (with worst trips and densest links) sized for LLM context after every run.
notes: ACMS already has richer analysis. Provider split (builder/generator/runner/modifier/metrics) is only a naming idea.
